attributes.name: RemotePosition
attributes.description: What we believe the position of a routed sound is. Safari freezes currentTime on HLS while AirPlaying and a Cast receiver's clock can stall, so a reported position is a hint rather than the truth, and this owns the rule for when to trust it over the stopwatch.

attributes.name: MediaLength
attributes.description: A stream with no obvious mime-type or extension often reports a duration that grows as it plays rather than Infinity, hacks were scattered to accomodate for this before. Now all that mess can mostly be contained in this class.

attributes.name: Sound
attributes.description: An identity-stable, lazy proxy for a playable url that delegates playback to a concrete connection (a BaseSound subclass) in connection.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The url this sound plays. Always a single string, even when you passed several urls or a promise.

fields.name: urls
fields.description: Every url this sound answers to, including the cast url.

fields.name: castUrl
fields.description: A url a cast device can fetch on its own. Defaults to url.

fields.name: connection
fields.description: Whatever is playing this sound right now. Failover and casting replace it, so read it rather than hold it.

fields.name: isPending
fields.description: The sound exists but no connection has resolved yet.

fields.name: isResolved
fields.description: A connection is attached.

fields.name: isLoading
fields.description: A load is in flight, or the connection is still buffering.

fields.name: isErrored
fields.description: Every playable connection was tried and none worked.

fields.name: errors
fields.description: What went wrong, one entry per connection that failed.

fields.name: error
fields.description: The active connection's error, if it has one.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Whatever you want to keep alongside the sound. Feeds the OS media controls.

fields.name: audioElement
fields.description: The underlying element, when the active connection uses one.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Where the playhead is, in milliseconds.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: How long the sound runs, in milliseconds. A live stream reports Infinity.

fields.name: currentTime
fields.description: The wall-clock time playing right now, for live and HLS streams.

fields.name: startTime
fields.description: The wall-clock time the stream begins, for live and HLS streams.

fields.name: endTime
fields.description: The wall-clock time the stream ends, for live and HLS streams.

fields.name: percentLoaded
fields.description: How much has downloaded, from 0 to 100, when the connection reports it.

fields.name: isBlocked
fields.description: The browser refused to autoplay, so the sound needs a user gesture.

fields.name: isReady
fields.description: The connection can start playing.

fields.name: isPlaying
fields.description: Audio is coming out right now.

fields.name: isPaused
fields.description: The sound is loaded and stopped at a position.

fields.name: isLoaded
fields.description: The connection has enough to play.

fields.name: hasPlayed
fields.description: The sound has played at least once.

fields.name: mimeType
fields.description: The audio type the connection worked out.

fields.name: isStream
fields.description: The sound is a live stream rather than a fixed recording.

fields.name: isRewindable
fields.description: The playhead can move backwards.

fields.name: isFastForwardable
fields.description: The playhead can move forwards.

fields.name: isSeekable
fields.description: The playhead can move to an arbitrary position.

fields.name: id3Tags
fields.description: ID3 tags read off the stream, when the connection supplies them.

fields.name: connectionName
fields.description: The active connection's display name, for example Native Audio.

fields.name: connectionKey
fields.description: The active connection's key, for example HLS.
